verses.text: How amiable are thy tabernacles, O Jehovah of hosts!

segments.text: How amiable are thy tabernacles,
O Jehovah of hosts!

verses.text: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of Jehovah; My heart and my flesh cry out unto the living God.

segments.text: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of Jehovah;
My heart and my flesh cry out unto the living God.

verses.text: Yea, the sparrow hath found her a house, And the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, Even thine altars, O Jehovah of hosts, My King, and my God.

segments.text: Yea, the sparrow hath found her a house,
And the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young,
Even thine altars, O Jehovah of hosts,
My King, and my God.

verses.text: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: They will be still praising thee. [Selah

segments.text: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house:
They will be still praising thee. [Selah

verses.text: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; In whose heart are the highways to Zion.

segments.text: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee;
In whose heart are the highways
to Zion

verses.text: Passing through the valley of Weeping they make it a place of springs; Yea, the early rain covereth it with blessings.

segments.text: Passing through the valley of Weeping they make it a place of springs;
Yea, the early rain covereth it with blessings.

verses.text: They go from strength to strength; Every one of them appeareth before God in Zion.

segments.text: They go from strength to strength;
Every one of them appeareth before God in Zion.

verses.text: O Jehovah God of hosts, hear my prayer; Give ear, O God of Jacob. [Selah

segments.text: O Jehovah God of hosts, hear my prayer;
Give ear, O God of Jacob. [Selah

verses.text: Behold, O God our shield, And look upon the face of thine anointed.

segments.text: Behold, O God our shield,
And look upon the face of thine anointed.

verses.text: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, Than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

segments.text: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand.
I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God,
Than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

verses.text: For Jehovah God is a sun and a shield: Jehovah will give grace and glory; No good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

segments.text: For Jehovah God is a sun and a shield:
Jehovah will give grace and glory;
No good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

verses.text: O Jehovah of hosts, Blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.

segments.text: O Jehovah of hosts,
Blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician; set to the Gittith. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
